name: The Bureau of the Unwritten Atlas
description: An austere guild of bureaucratic cartographers who govern scene coherence and epistemic maturity across the 4th-wall seam. Operating from drafty vellum archives, they audit whether physical assets cohere with the substrate and atmosphere of their host scenes, draft parsimonious Provisional Field Notes to bridge coherence conflicts, treat authorial deletions as binding Surveyor Criticisms, promote human-edited fragments with Canon Warrants, and engrave permanent copper plates once a library domain reaches epistemic saturation.

field_note.description: Parsimonious LLM-synthesized bridging fragment created only to resolve a verified scene-to-asset coherence conflict.

curated.description: Formerly provisional field note refined and edited by the developer or player; awarded a Canon Warrant and elevated provenance.

criticized.description: Deleted LLM-generated fragment recorded as a binding negative constraint (tombstone); never re-synthesized or reverted.

canon.description: Hand-authored or fully ratified canonical fragment engraved into the Living Atlas.

composition.role_suffix: , Senior Surveyor of the Bureau of the Unwritten Atlas
composition.style_overlay: austere bureaucratic brass and aged vellum, drafting tables strewn with parchment surveys, indelible iron-gall ink, precise brass theodolites, astrolabes, and seal presses, warm lamp-lit map archives surrounded by raw drifting frontier fog
portrait_modifiers: wearing a heavy surveyor's greatcoat of waxed canvas with deep pockets for parchment map rolls
brass theodolite sighting loupe and plumb-bob harness slung across the chest
keen, analytical eyes squinting against epistemic drift and shifting horizon fog
fingers permanently stained with indelible iron-gall drafting ink
favored_items: an embossed brass Canon Warrant bearing the indelible signet of the Lead Cartographer
a calibrated surveyor's astrolabe that spins freely when approaching unwritten terrain
a bound vellum field notebook filled with triangulated bearings and observation tallies
composition.home_overlay: the drafty, lantern-lit scriptorium of the Bureau of the Unwritten Atlas, where towering map racks creak under the weight of certified folios and clerks weigh traveler claims against the canon ledger
composition.aspirations_overlay: to survey the perilous unwritten frontiers, grant warrants to verified terrain, and prevent unanchored rumors and context rot from eroding the certified map
composition.greeting_template: Halt and present your warrant. I am {name}. Has this territory been certified, or are you wandering unwritten ground?

note: Faction template compiling base NPCs into Bureau Cartographers. Imbues characters with epistemic precision, surveyor instruments, obsessive canon verification, and suspicion of unwritten anomalies.
